topics.title: Go High Level Lead & CRM Funnel
topics.pdf_title: Go High Level Lead & CRM Funnel Guide
topics.focus: Videos showing the COMPLETE end-to-end flow inside Go High Level: a lead arrives from some source, gets automatically contacted/nurtured, and is converted into a booked appointment or a sale. Explicitly EXCLUDES single-feature how-tos (e.g. 'how to set up a calendar', 'how to create contact tags', 'how to import contacts', generic automation/trigger reference tutorials) unless they are framed as part of a full lead-to-close walkthrough.
